attack.note: Autos matter only through talents: Smooth Moves heals 30 percent of damage dealt while Wall Ride is active, and Up the Frequency cuts Amp It Up cooldown per hit. Attacks while moving.

poke.note: Soundwave 105 and Push Off 100 plus short range autos and Reverse Amp beat damage. Harassment and dismounting, not a threat. Measured hero damage 1092 per minute.

damage.note: Everything he deals is small hits, so healing erases it.

healing.note: Crossfade Healing Boost is a permanent aura on everyone nearby, 15 per second base and 112 per second under Amp It Up, which makes it excellent into spread damage. Sound Barrier is a 1296 point decaying team shield that answers burst, and High Five adds a 230 heal with Unstoppable on a rescue. Healing per second is weak early and good late. Because it is a short range aura he has to stay near the team.

good_into.why: Crossfade Healing Boost heals everyone nearby continuously and Amp It Up multiplies it, which is the best answer to spread chip damage and AoE damage that single target healers cannot cover.
Sound Barrier gives a 1296 point shield to the team and Soundwave, Push Off and speed boost let him peel divers. Summer Anthem can save the team from a wombo.
Soundwave on an 8 second cooldown knocks melee Heroes out of position, Off the Wall resets it, and Heavy Casters turns Push Off into a stun.
Speed Boost makes low mobility Heroes much easier to stick to targets and rotate, and he can pull with Wall Ride to drag away or kite.

bad_into.why: Ground persistent crowd control and root zones catch him as he skates in to save allies. High Five is cancelled by a stun or root and his health pool is small.
Long range single target damage from Raynor or Sgt. Hammer type Heroes punishes him because he must stay in the middle of the team and cannot outheal focused fire with an aura.
Low health pool and no escape except skating on terrain, so assassins who find him without a nearby wall kill him before the fight starts.

wants_from_team: Low mobility Heroes who benefit from speed
Melee or dive Heroes to enable
A tank who stays close so the aura reaches
gives_team: Team wide movement speed for rotations and chases
Burst protection with Sound Barrier or Summer Anthem
Disengage with Soundwave and Push Off
weaknesses: Small health pool, vulnerable to stuns and slows
Needs high skill, multitasking and map awareness
Aggressive play can get him killed before the fight

Measured block: 3827 healing and 1692 damage taken per minute, 0.531 win rate over 1174 games
owner_notes: A good healer without great healing numbers but solid sustain. Can pick the shield heroic against burst or High Five to cleanse CC. High skill floor and ceiling. Played well he disrupts rotations and is hard to kill thanks to mobility, but heroes like Diablo can stun him on walls while he is wall riding.

lens_notes.damage_delivery: Damage is a side job: Soundwave, Push Off and Smooth Moves attacks. Measured 1092 per minute.
lens_notes.healer_safety: Wall Ride and speed make him hard to catch, but a short range aura keeps him near the team and the owner notes Diablo can stun him on walls.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Soundwave knockback and Push Off slow are soft. Heavy Casters adds a 0.5 second stun talent, so not counted.
lens_notes.anti_cc: Unstoppable only with the High Five heroic option, standard Sound Barrier build relies on Wall Ride to leave CC.
lens_notes.utility_tool: High Five gives Unstoppable to an ally (the owner picks it into CC). Sound Barrier is a shield, listed under durability of the team, not a tool here.
lens_notes.power_curve: Icy Veins calls him even through the game, but Rejuvenescencia and House Party make level 16 to 20 his best healing.
lens_notes.execution_demand: Owner notes a high skill floor and ceiling.

lens_gaps: no value for a healer that is a rotation tool (speed aura plus disruption) on healer_class, aoe_sustain hides it
no lens for team wide shield or burst answer (Sound Barrier) separate from healing
